    urls=[]
    for u in re.findall(r'https?://[^\s\"\'<>]+',line):
        v=urlsplit(u);urls.append(v.scheme+'://'+(v.hostname or '')+v.path)
    models=re.findall(r'(?i)(?:opencode/)?deepseek[-/._a-z0-9]+',line)
    models=[m for m in models if not m.endswith('.com')]
